content: I noticed something interesting: this translation seems to exhibit a certain mirror symmetry along the tilt axis. Specifically, between two consecutive load drops, the atoms appear to move by some displacement in x direction, accompanied by some displacement in the z direction (i.e., along the tilt axis). Also, the atomic configurations before and after this motion might be mirror images of each other with respect to the z direction. If this is the case, then after two consecutive load drops, applying the mirror operation twice should restore the original atomic configuration. Could you check whether the net displacement between two frames separated by one load drop corresponds to a pure slidng displacement? If so, could you help me determine how many <112> directions this displacement corresponds to? As I recall, the x-direction of the bottom grain is a <112> direction, right?
